content: Verify that Codex receives the repository rules through its native AGENTS.md discovery, finish the Nix entry-points check inherited from the interrupted ZCode session, and record the resulting repository boundary without treating the optional Claude bridge as a Codex hook.

The session resumed two uncommitted files from base revision 154a2fbb8b0fd48126253ae098a2539dfff99267: nix/checks/default.nix adds checks.x86_64-linux.entry-points and nix/lib/source.nix expands the independent agentRecords fileset. The prior run had fixed the build sandbox path from mkdir .git to mkdir repo/.git but had not rerun the check.

Official OpenAI documentation confirms Codex constructs its instruction chain once per run and natively reads AGENTS.md from the project root down to the working directory. The repository-local CLAUDE.md and .claude hooks remain an optional Claude bridge; Codex enforcement continues through AGENTS.md, the tool-agnostic pre-commit gate, and Nix checks.

The first resumed nix build of checks.x86_64-linux.entry-points passed the Agent record validator and then failed at test -x repo/.claude/hooks/pre_edit.py. The hook is intentionally mode 100644 and is launched through python3 in .claude/settings.json, so executable permission is not part of its contract.

The entry-points fixture now initializes repo/ as the actual synthetic Git root, requires non-empty AGENTS.md and the CLAUDE.md import, requires the executable tool-agnostic pre-commit hook, and checks the Claude settings plus both Python hook files for presence without inventing an executable-bit requirement.

nix build path:.#checks.x86_64-linux.entry-points -L passed after the fixture correction; the isolated source also passed tools/check-agent-records.py with 9 sessions, 74 events, and 80 Markdown files.

Repository verification passed before the content commit: tools/test-check-agent-records.py reported 23/23 cases; nix develop path:. configured and built the dev preset, then ctest --preset dev passed 16/16 tests including component-graph and agent-records-selftest.
nix flake check path:. -L evaluated all packages, checks, dev shells, and the formatter, built the changed agent-records, format, and entry-points derivations, and ended with all checks passed.

Content commit 3fe0ace283c857f926b4d9a9555438a5df7e835e records the independent agentRecords fileset expansion and the new entry-points Nix check. The commit contains only nix/checks/default.nix and nix/lib/source.nix; session and checkpoint records follow separately.

No product constraint, milestone decision, or open-decision ledger row changed. The durable outcome is build-system enforcement of already-established repository entry points; no memory or experience record was promoted.
